free_tier.stated: Bittensor subnet 19 (Rayon Labs) advertises Llama 3.1 8B at 'Less Than $0.00 / M Tokens', footnoted 'currently'. The app exposes an API key page and an OpenAI-compatible endpoint at api.nineteen.ai/v1.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: A free OpenAI-compatible endpoint is a drop-in for any agent loop that expects a base_url and a key, so it chains with local tooling without a gateway.

limits.value: The price is zero while the subnet subsidises it; no limit is published, so the first real limit is an undocumented per-key rate limit and the second is the subsidy ending.
